title: GOAT-Bench: Safety Insights to Large Multimodal Models through Meme-Based Social Abuse
reasoning: The paper focuses on safety and social abuse detection in multimodal memes, evaluating categories like hatefulness, misogyny, and offensiveness. While it includes religious groups as a target category for hate speech detection, it does not benchmark or evaluate religious doctrines, faith traditions, theology, or formal ethical/moral reasoning frameworks. It is primarily an AI safety and bias evaluation tool.
